Lands of Theia World Primer

Vendor: Samurai Sheepdog
Type: Book
Price: 4.99

In the Lands of Theia, adventure never waits.

Welcome to the world primer for the first campaign setting that details the shattered worlds for Pathfinder 1st Edition. Magical sky races, volcanic jungles, steam-powered metropolises, and continent-spanning cave networks are only some of the wonders that await adventurers in this fantasty realm.

The options presented herein allow players to build memorable characters in Theia. Gamemasters will enjoy a first look at the world and its many varied people, while spotlights and story hooks act as windows through which we introduce plots to help jumpstart a game or expanded upon in future adventure paths.

Highlights

This primer includes a truncated set of playable options to help show off what Lands of Theia has to offer. In addition to the 3 classes mentioned above, you'll find brief summaries of how the core races are represented on this world. If you want something a little different, we also included stats for playable gnolls, whose roll in this world is quite interesting. Archetypes and other character options round out the player section with ways to enjoy something you're familiar with in a different flavor.

For gamemasters, we offer a look at what the world itself is like, including an in depth spread of information detailing the country of Wutente to help them begin a campaign in Theia.

Name's Games May 2025 Collection – Unchained Clockworker for Pathfinder 1e

Vendor: Samurai Sheepdog
Type: Book
Price: 10.00

==Clockworker Special Edition==

This May, we have a special release. This entire month is dedicated to the unchained clockworker, based on the Clockworker class from Headless Hydra Games by M.J. Nixon. If you get the chance, check it out. It's a great class in and of itself; much like the summoner to the unchained summoner.

* Unchained clockworkers are an alternate class for the unchained summoner base class. They are balanced against the other classes in Pathfinder. They can prepare up to 6th-level spells, drones, bonus feats, and a construct companion they maintain.

* Drones are tiny constructs that follow very basic functions like combat, conduit, shield, and utility. The unchained clockworker can activate a limited number of them per day, and each has charges they spend before being dismantled.

* Over 60 innovations that can be applied to the unchained clockworker's servitor for between 1 and 4 innovation points.

* The spell list of an unchained clockworker is expanded to include most of the other main books in the Pathfinder 1e collection. It has been updated to play a more subtle role in their abilities compared to the ability to deploy and control their construct companions, but the ability to utilize war magic through those companions still exists for the cost of innovation points.

* Favored class bonuses for almost 15 different ancestries are available to help show off their ties to that class.

* 6 original spells from the clockworker make their return for easy referencing.

==Servitors==

* The servitor is the unchained clockworker's main focus. It is a construct built from the ground up with a chassis that dictates its general form and shape, and housing that defines some of the more fantastic things it can do. The unchained clockworker uses innovations to improve the servitor as they both gain experience.

* Servitor chassis include biped, quadruped, serpentine, and wheeled options.

* Cog sprocket servitors are simplistic constructs created by self-taught clockworkers. They gain the most straightforward innovations and are among the easiest options for newer players of this otherwise complex class.

* Composite servitors are the result of collaborations between top inventors and clockworkers, gaining the ability to explode like an inventor's base invention. Eventually, they can also become collapsible and hydraulic, and their clockworker can perform haphazard repairs or even rapid recalibrations on the fly.

* Contemporary servitors are the pedigree of their kind, built by studied and collegiate clockworkers who trained for years at academies to learn standardized formats and creation guidelines to make the most of their companions. They can have any chassis, are more than capable with weapons, and can even self-repair in a pinch.

* Magitech servitors utilize war magic in their systems to overpower enemies with spells that used to be relegated to the clockworker herself. They effectively counter other spellcasters with spell resistance, see in darkness, and eventually freedom of movement.

S-Class Characters: Clockworkers – Pathfinder 1e Alternate Clockworker Class

Vendor: Samurai Sheepdog
Type: Book
Price: 1.00

==What's Inside==

The s-class clockworker is a 6th-level spellcasting class with a litany of bonus feats they can gain, drones they can deploy, and a versatile companion they can build from the ground up.

* 2 new basic functions for drones. Deploy scouting and thievery drones after choosing them with the new drone function class feature, or with the Extra Drone Function feat.

* 4 advanced functions for drones that you can gain in lieu of a bonus feat.

* S-Class Servitors gain up to 26 innovations you can give them, with greater flexibility than unchained servitors.

* 5 Servitor models for the housings introduced here and with the unchained clockworker. These provide guidance when building your servitor, but are not required.

* New fey and inevitable housings for unchained clockworkers.

* A full, 20-level s-class that you can bring to the table right beside others like it, including the original s-class, the summoner.

* A sample of 0- through 6th-level spells for easy reference.

==New options available to standard, unchained, and s-class clockworkers.==

* Tauric and winged chassis offer new variety in what servitors you can build.

* 12 new innovations across 1 to 4 points. Install an exhaust pipe, carve fey magic into your servitor's housing, or give it an extra head.

"The original Pathfinder RPG summoner class is fine."

I'm glad you think so. In that case, you're going to love the s-class clockworker, which has been balanced around the same general power level as the original summoner while still remaining fully compatible with a standard adventuring party. In fact, we are retuning every other class to be on par with that one, and the clockworker is just one such offering. If this proves popular, we'll be sure to release more, and eventually collect them into a full book for POD.

In addition to the s-class description, this is a full-use document for your character. No need to look at other books unless you need to know greater details, such as feat prerequisites and such (we intentionally summarize these so they're usable, but you have a reason to pick those up if you want to use them outside of the context of the s-class character).
